summary: Candidate is a distinct SDK-specific agent tracking setup for Mistral (>=0.32.0) with AgentOps integration. It differs semantically from existing skills: not a generic observability framework (OpenTelemetry/Spring Boot migration), but a concrete session-level configuration workflow for a specific SDK. Peer candidates (CamelAI, SwarmZero, generic AI Agent Observability) suggest this is one of multiple SDK-specific implementations in the same family, but each targets a different agent framework and should remain separate skills. No existing skill covers Mistral+AgentOps integration.
